profile.headline: Java Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Versatile and detail-oriented Software Engineer with 10 years of experience developing enterprise applications, distributed systems, and government/defense RD solutions. 
Experienced in designing integration services, modernizing development processes, and resolving interoperability and deployment challenges across bare-metal, containerized, and cloud environments. 
Driven by technical curiosity, a commitment to delivering reliable software, and a mindset of continuously learning, refining, and improving both systems and engineering practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Contributed to the development and integration of cognitive agent systems for government and defense RD logistics programs, helping transition experimental capabilities into software that could operate with existing military systems. 
● Designed and built the Data Integration Mapping Service (DIMS) middleware application, integrating 3+ external Army and partner systems to transform external payloads into internal domain models for reliable downstream processing. 
● Supported 2+ successful military exercises and experimentation events as an on-site integration engineer, diagnosing and resolving interoperability, and deployment, networking, and backend issues under live field conditions. 
● Restored and maintained application functionality in bare-metal and field environments by diagnosing issues across application, messaging, database, networking, and host-system layers, often under time-sensitive integration and testing conditions. 
● Collaborated directly with partner-organization engineers to identify integration gaps, validate end-to-end workflows, and deliver software fixes that kept demonstrations and live testing operational.
positions.insights: Skills: Java Development · Software Design · Hibernate · REST APIs · Apache Kafka · Gradle · Spring Boot · Docker

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
● Spearheaded modernization of the AWS EC2 application deployment process by replacing manual SSH-based deployments with an automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS CodeDeploy, improving reliability, traceability, and rollback capabilities while reducing human error and engineering effort. 
● Implemented and documented RESTful APIs for microservices using Spring Boot and Swagger/OpenAPI, improving service integration and API discoverability. 
● Maintained AWS API Gateway configurations, including CORS setup for newly defined API endpoints, enabling reliable cross origin application access. 
● Supported deployments to development and staging environments on AWS EC2 and assisted in building CI/CD pipelines from Bitbucket to AWS using Azure DevOps. 
● Monitored application and infrastructure behavior using AWS CloudWatch and supported issue triage across deployed environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · Java · Software Development · Agile Methodologies · Git · Hibernate · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Maven · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Problem Solving

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
● Collaborated with business analysts to break down requirements, design solutions, and prepare specification documentation for software change requests, improving development clarity and alignment. 
● Implemented backend application changes and user interfaces using Java, JSF, and PrimeFaces, delivering enhancements aligned with business requirements. 
● Created and modified SQL queries, triggers, and packages in Oracle to support application enhancements and reporting needs, improving data processing and reporting capabilities. 
● Developed Java/MyBatis batch jobs to extract bi-weekly database records for reporting, logging, and downstream processing, enabling consistent scheduled data delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring MVC · Hibernate · Maven · Spring Framework · Problem Solving

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Supported business enhancement releases for VISA, MasterCard, AMEX, JCB, and UnionPay by implementing required specifications in a Java/J2SE ISO 8583 credit message formatting application, maintaining payment-network compatibility. 
● Led data-gathering activities for a client legacy-system upgrade by analyzing existing data formats and table relationships across multiple systems, informing modernization planning. 
● Produced an Entity-Relationship Diagram and proposed table architecture to support modernization planning and future application development, providing a structured foundation for database design.
positions.insights: Skills: Jira · MySQL · Maven · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · RESTful WebServices · REST APIs · Software Testing · Core Java

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
● Supported the Vendavo intelligent pricing application using Java/J2EE, JBoss, Oracle 11g, JasperReports, and Agile/Scrum practices. 
● Resolved incident reports and software bugs, supported client change-request meetings, and prepared system requirement and source-code modification documentation. 
● Created deployment and rollback documentation and supported migration of the Vendavo system from Windows Server 2000 to Windows Server 2012 R2. 
● Reinstalled and reconfigured Vendavo, JBoss, database components, batch files, and scheduled jobs; supported system testing and user acceptance testing.
